_doc: 유행 20년 편 원화 12시트 (2×2). 참조: jiwoo_board.png + tasting.png 만. Codex $imagegen -m gpt-6-sol, 원본 Drive 영상/20261123-curiosity-fashion20/art/<시트>.png, 프롬프트 <시트>.txt
common:
Create ONE wide 16:9 landscape image that is a perfect full-bleed 2x2 sheet of four separate 16:9 film frames (four equal rectangles, no gutters, no margins, no borders). Each frame is a new frame of the SAME animated film as the two attached images.

THE CHARACTER (most important): Ji-woo is the woman on the first attached image, 'jiwoo_board' - a board of panels cut directly from the finished films (eight face panels on top, four full-body panels below). Wherever Ji-woo appears, draw the SAME person in the SAME drawing method as on that board: the same face and face proportions, the same eyes, nose and mouth, the same hair (dark, softly wavy, chin-length bob with a side part and a small brown hair clip on her right side), the same adult body proportions as in the full-body panels, the same outline weight, the same colouring, the same light and the same surface texture. Do NOT make her younger, cuter or simpler than the board, and do NOT make her more realistic or more detailed than the board.

THE DRAWING METHOD (equally important): every frame - including frames without Ji-woo, the other people, the buildings, the objects and the backgrounds - is drawn as if the same artist drew more frames for the same film as the two attached images: the same dark outline weight and line quality, the same soft cel colouring with the same few light and shadow steps, the same warm gentle light, and backgrounds painted with the same level of detail as in the second attached image 'tasting'. Stone, concrete, brick, marble, metal and water are painted the way wood, shelves and cloth are painted in the attached images: soft hand-painted animation background art. No photographic or semi-realistic rendering, no photographic textures, no oil-painting look, no 3D look. Diagram-like frames are also painted in this same animation style.

CLOTHES AND PROPS (her face, hair and the drawing method never change): at home in the present day (a Korean apartment, November evening) Ji-woo wears an oatmeal-cream knit sweater and charcoal-grey wide-leg trousers. THE JACKET (the key prop, always identical): her mother's short cropped wine-red (burgundy) zip-up jacket from the mid-2000s, waist-length, small stand collar, boxy padded shoulders, two flap pockets, no logo. HER OWN COAT (bought this year): a long oversized dark-brown wool coat. Ji-woo's MOTHER (an invented character, about 50): shoulder-length softly permed dark hair, warm round face, gentle eyes, a beige cardigan over a striped top - drawn in exactly the same animation style as Ji-woo. The mother when young (about 28, around 2004): long straight dark hair, wearing the same wine-red cropped jacket with low-rise bootcut jeans.

ACCURACY: period clothes must match their years exactly: 1830s-1850s fashion plates (bonnets, wide sleeves, full skirts), 1859 (huge bell-shaped crinoline skirts), 1904 Berlin (Edwardian S-bend silhouette, large hats, long trailing skirts), 1911 (narrow 'hobble' skirt, ankle length, big hat), 1919 and 1920s (men in three-piece suits with round collars; women in loose dropped-waist dresses), 1926 (straight narrow knee-length dropped-waist dress, cloche hat), 1937-1940 (padded shoulders, mid-calf skirts, men in double-breasted suits), around 1800-1810 ('Empire' gowns: very high waist under the bust, long straight white muslin skirt to the floor, small puffed sleeves), ancient Greek women in chiton (short or knee-length, wide open neckline). All historical people are invented-looking (not portraits of real people). No brand logos, no readable labels, no store signs with letters; phone and computer screens show only images or plain glow.
tail: Keep the main subject of each frame above the bottom fifth of the frame (subtitle area). Absolutely no text, letters, digits, logos, inscriptions or watermarks anywhere (inscriptions on buildings are left blank).

sheets.wardrobe: Top left: a Korean apartment bedroom on a November evening, warm lamp light, Ji-woo has opened her mother's tall wooden wardrobe to take out winter clothes and her hand has stopped in mid-air, surprised, long coats hanging inside. Top right: close-up inside the wardrobe: at the very back, between long dark coats, hangs THE JACKET (short cropped wine-red zip-up jacket with boxy shoulders) on a wooden hanger, soft light falling on it. Bottom left: a present-day clothing store this week, a rack of new arrivals with a mannequin wearing an almost identical short cropped wine-red jacket, bright shop lighting, no signs or letters. Bottom right: Ji-woo holding THE JACKET up on its hanger, turning toward the bedroom door with a curious look, about to ask a question.
sheets.album: Top left: close-up of a hand holding a slightly faded printed photograph; in the photo (drawn in the same animation style) the young mother, about 28, stands on a mid-2000s Seoul street wearing THE JACKET with low-rise bootcut jeans, smiling. Top right: a few years ago: Ji-woo as a high-school student (same face, a little younger, school uniform) sitting on the floor with a family photo album open on her lap, laughing out loud and pointing at a photo. Bottom left: present day: Ji-woo standing in the bedroom quietly looking at THE JACKET hanging on the open wardrobe door, thoughtful, a small admiring smile - now she finds it pretty. Bottom right: Ji-woo's mother standing in the bedroom doorway, answering casually with a warm smile, one hand on the door frame, lamp light.
sheets.laver: Top left: 1920s London, a large museum print room with tall wooden cabinets and wide flat drawers of old prints and drawings, an invented slim young curator in a 1920s three-piece suit seen in three-quarter view standing at a table covered with old engravings, soft window light. Top right: close-up of the curator's hand holding a magnifying glass over an old hand-coloured engraving of people in 1830s clothes (bonnets, wide sleeves, full skirts), studying the clothes to date the picture. Bottom left: late 1930s, the same curator, now in his late thirties, writing a manuscript at a desk with a lamp, stacks of fashion prints and a fresh hardbound book without any title. Bottom right: a museum gallery: one identical old-fashioned dress on a dress form, with four visitors from different decades around it reacting differently - one shocked, one laughing, one charmed, one admiring.
sheets.phone: Top left: close-up of a hand scrolling a smartphone photo gallery, the screen shows a grid of small blurry colourful photo thumbnails (no text, no icons), cosy evening room behind. Top right: a young woman (an invented ordinary person, not Ji-woo) in front of a bedroom mirror in the morning around 2016, wearing that year's outfit, nodding with satisfaction. Bottom left: Ji-woo lifting THE JACKET out of the wardrobe by its wooden hanger, holding it at arm's length, studying it. Bottom right: close-up of a hand placing a wooden ruler across a 19th-century hand-coloured fashion plate of a woman in a wide full skirt, the ruler measuring the skirt's width.
sheets.kroeber: Top left: 1919 California, an invented American anthropologist in a 1910s three-piece suit at a big wooden desk piled high with stacks of old bound fashion magazines, opening one, late afternoon light, a notebook of figures beside him. Top right: close-up of his hand laying a ruler on a fashion-plate figure, measuring from waist to skirt hem, pencil and columns of small handwritten marks without readable text. Bottom left: an 1859 Paris salon, women in enormous bell-shaped crinoline skirts filling the room, the skirts so wide they barely pass each other. Bottom right: a 1911 city street, women in very narrow ankle-length hobble skirts and large hats, taking tiny steps.
sheets.wave: Top left: an enormous slow pendulum swinging in a tall hall, its weight drawn as a dress silhouette, faint motion arcs, dreamy warm light, the feeling of a whole century in one swing. Top right: 1940, two invented researchers - a man in his sixties and a younger woman in late-1930s clothes - at a very long table on which fashion plates from three centuries are laid out in a row, from 1600s gowns at one end to 1930s dresses at the other. Bottom left: 1926 street, a young woman in a straight narrow knee-length dropped-waist dress and cloche hat, the narrowest skirt silhouette. Bottom right: 1937 New York, an invented woman author at her desk with a hand-drawn chart of wavy cycle curves (no text), glancing at a wall calendar with a rueful, embarrassed expression.
sheets.study: Top left: a present-day university research room, three invented young researchers in front of a big wall screen covered by a grid of thousands of tiny fashion images (dresses from many decades), one pointing. Top right: close-up of a computer screen showing a row of simple dress silhouettes from different decades, each with thin coloured horizontal lines marking the hem, the neckline and the waistline (no text, no numbers). Bottom left: a 1960s-70s city street where every woman wears either a very short mini dress or a long maxi skirt - just two choices. Bottom right: a present-day city street with many women whose skirts are all different lengths at once - mini, knee, midi, maxi - mixed together.
sheets.family: Top left: Ji-woo standing beside the open wardrobe looking at her smartphone (screen a plain glowing rectangle), THE JACKET folded over her arm, curious. Top right: THE KEY SCENE: in the bedroom, Ji-woo holds up THE JACKET between herself and her mother; the mother laughs warmly and a little wistfully, Ji-woo smiles in amused curiosity - two different smiles over the same jacket. Bottom left: close-up of the mother's face, laughing softly with a faraway nostalgic look, eyes slightly moist. Bottom right: close-up of Ji-woo's face, a fresh curious smile, looking at the jacket as something new.
sheets.simmel: Top left: 1904 Berlin boulevard, two elegant upper-class ladies in brand-new large hats and Edwardian S-bend dresses strolling, people turning to look. Top right: the same boulevard a few years later: many ordinary young women now wear copies of those hats and dresses, while the two elegant ladies walk past in a completely different new style, glancing back with mild disdain. Bottom left: a dusty attic, an old wooden trunk opened, folded dresses from long ago inside, a beam of light with floating dust - forgotten things. Bottom right: a clothing rack of garments swaying back and forth as if pushed, motion arcs, hangers sliding from one end to the other.
sheets.today: Top left: a present-day Korean clothing store with mid-2000s style items (capri pants, low-rise jeans, colourful jelly sandals, bangles) on display; a woman in her late thirties smiles nostalgically while a teenage girl next to her looks excited and amazed, no signs or letters. Top right: around 2004, a Seoul street at dusk: the young mother (about 28, long straight hair) wearing THE JACKET with low-rise bootcut jeans, walking with friends dressed in similar mid-2000s fashion. Bottom left: a cosy vintage clothing shop, young customers in their early twenties browsing racks of old clothes with delight. Bottom right: two young people in the present day wearing vintage pieces mixed with current clothes (an old denim jacket over a modern hoodie, a vintage skirt with chunky sneakers), walking and laughing.
sheets.mirror: Top left: Ji-woo wearing THE JACKET in front of a full-length mirror in the bedroom; in the mirror the padded shoulders look too wide and the waist-length cut sits awkwardly over her sweater, she frowns slightly, puzzled. Top right: around 1805, a Paris salon, women in high-waisted white muslin Empire gowns with long straight skirts to the floor and small puffed sleeves, elegant and modest. Bottom left: an ancient Greek woman in a knee-length chiton with a wide open neckline, standing by marble columns in bright Mediterranean light (an old-world reference). Bottom right: Ji-woo wearing THE JACKET over her own charcoal wide-leg trousers, posing in the mirror; behind her the mother, arms folded, shakes her head with an amused smile.
sheets.end: Top left: Ji-woo in THE JACKET looking at herself in the mirror again, calm and relaxed, a quiet understanding smile. Top right: Ji-woo, still wearing THE JACKET, hanging her own long dark-brown wool coat at the very back of her mother's wardrobe on a wooden hanger. Bottom left: many years later, an invented young woman in unfamiliar future-looking but simple clothes opens the same wooden wardrobe and her hand stops, surprised, looking at the long dark-brown coat at the back. Bottom right: close-up of the back of the wardrobe: the long dark-brown wool coat hanging on a wooden hanger in soft light, everything quiet.
